THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands hereby declare, under Sub-section(1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land describedbelow is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under theprovisions of that Act.

An allotment of land called ‘‘Pihille Ele Hena’’ in total extentof About 0.0624 Hectare, depicted in the Advance Tracing No.Maha/AKR/2014/560 dated 23.10.2014, prepared by the SurveyorGeneral situated in the Village of Dunuwila Viharagama in SarasiyaPaththuwa Korale Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary'sDivision of Akurana in Kandy District, Central Province and boundedas follows:

Lot ‘A’ – Phille Ele Hena – Extent: 0.0624 HectareNorth: Remaining portion of the said land and Road (PradeshiyaSabha); East: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South: Road (PradeshiyaSabha) and remaining portion of the said land; West: Remainingportion of the said land.
M. K. A. D. S. Gunawardana,Minister of Lands.
My Reference No.: 4-3/9/2014/WS/141.Ministry of Lands“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.04th June, 2015.

provisions of that Act.

Kandy Municipal Council area) in the Divisional Secretary's
Division of Kandy and Gangawata Korale in Kandy District, Central
Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Galkaduwawatta – Extent: About 0.0012 Hectare
North: Lot Nos. 8 and 9 in P.P.Maha 3490; East: Lot Nos. 8
and 9 in P.P.Maha 3490 and Lot B; South: Assmt. No. 28/3 in
Pitakanda Road claimed by Y. M. Somalatha; West: Assmt.
No. 28/3 in Pitakanda Road claimed by Y. M. Somalatha and
Lot No. 8 in P.P.Maha 3490.
